description: Environment crops from art/references/psychopomp-environment-reference.webp (1565x1005). Each crop keeps its decorations in their original context (walls, niches, statues, torches, candles, chains, arches, floor); cut-out sprites of single objects would carry the busy background with them. Coordinates: src = [x, y, w, h] in the reference; scale maps the reference height (1005) to the view height (540). Anchors place a crop against an edge of the 960x540 view; feather = soft alpha edges (view px) so crops blend into the procedural stone behind them.

crops.contains: hanging chains, wall torch, candle stands, statue niche, skull niche, candles on the floor
